newsitem.title: FRANCE: French spending decree to be released Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: French spending decree to be released Wednesday.

text.p: Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn will announce a government decree on Wednesday enshrining spending measures contained in Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's maiden speech to parliament in June, the finance ministry said on Tuesday.

The decree will be unveiled at a news conference at 0630 GMT on Wednesday. It will cover the budgetary effects of Jospin's speech that included promise of a quadrupling of back to school allowances, a four percent increase in the minimum wage and first measures to promote jobs for youth.
The decree will cover the outlay of possibly around 10 billion francs and be offset by cancelling some budget credits, the government has said. It will not worsen the budget deficit.
The decree is to be published in the Official Journal on Thursday.
